method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reverse reconstruction of universal instantiation and the substitution/satisfaction bridge, and exact formula, macro, controlled-token, identifier and reference comparison after documented OLFOL-004 projection. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Substitution as the syntactic operation behind universal instantiation, its restrictions, and its semantic dependence on term values and modified assignments.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A derivation system should derive P(a) from universally quantified P(v_0), generalized as inferring A(t) from forall-x A(x) by removing the quantifier and replacing x with t. Constants are terms and functions build more complex terms, but the replacement relation must be defined precisely.
samples.checks: Concrete and general schemas, inference-rule purpose, formula/term/variable parameters and three closing questions are retained; OLFOL-004 only repairs the concrete atomic formula's bracketing.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Substitution cannot blindly replace every x by every t, so it is defined inductively. The resulting rule is semantically good because forall-x A(x) entails A(t), and satisfaction of A(t) depends only on t's denoted domain element m: it agrees with A(x) under the assignment modified to send x to m, even when t contains variables.
samples.checks: Both substitution restrictions, inductive method, entailment claim, term-value dependence, satisfaction biconditional, modified assignment and variable-containing-term caveat remain exact.

source_observations: OLFOL-004 repairs the source's misplaced v_0 argument so the concrete premise is the unary formula P(v_0) inside the universal quantifier, matching the general schema immediately below.
The target uses glossary-backed आदेशन and preserves the distinction between syntactic term substitution and semantic assignment modification.
All formulas, macros, controlled tokens, identifiers and references match the frozen source after the unit-specific correction projection.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The capture-avoidance restrictions are only motivated here and defined later.
